shots.visual_event: In Platform 13’s sealed control room, Maya exposes a dead telegraph built around thirteen concentric clock gears.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “It once called every train except his.”

shots.visual_event: Tick places his segmented tail into the machine while remaining firmly on four paws; cyan time flows from the blue tail tip.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “Tick, stop. That gear is you.”

shots.visual_event: Inside the train, every carriage clock jumps backward exactly one minute; Arin hears Meera through static.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera, distorted: “Arin—Door Thirteen is not an exit.”

shots.visual_event: Passenger Zero’s cracked hand reaches through the telegraph signal and tries to pull Meera into the mirror.
Tick bites through his own tail connector; the severed blue-tipped segment locks into the machine and the hand vanishes.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “He gave the station one of his minutes.”

shots.visual_event: Tick staggers but stays quadruped. The telegraph prints a clean geometric route: CAR 04 / HOME.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “Arin heard us. We do it again.”
